summary.en: A polished HTML5 Pac-Man replica with multiple mazes, smart ghost AI and power-ups all included.
summary.zh: 国产高质量 HTML5 吃豆人复刻，关卡、幽灵 AI、道具一应俱全。

description.en: Chomp every pellet to clear the maze; grab a power pellet to flip the hunt and chase the ghosts down. A ghost's touch costs a life, and you only get three.
description.zh: 操控吃豆人吃光所有豆子过关，吃到大力丸后可反追幽灵；被幽灵碰到减一条命，三条命用完结束。

howto.en: Arrow keys or WASD to move through the maze.
howto.zh: 方向键在迷宫中移动，吃光豆子，避开幽灵。

tip.en: One of the most complete open-source Pac-Man clones, with clearly commented ghost pathfinding AI. Documentation in Chinese keeps the modding bar low, and the map data is editable for custom levels.
tip.zh: 完成度最高的开源吃豆人之一，幽灵寻路 AI 注释清晰。中文文档，二次开发门槛低；地图数据可编辑，能自制关卡。
